svg.title: Presentation Skills
svg.desc: A skill any coding agent can follow to build HTML decks for non-designers, then export PDF, PNG or PPTX that match the HTML pixel for pixel. 34 design templates; 4 export formats; Any agent Claude Code, Codex.
